prompt: What should volunteers do with gloves left unmatched?
promptZh: 志工應如何處理沒有配對成功的散裝手套？

options.text: Put them back in the bin they came from.
options.whyZh: 原文說沒配好就放回原箱，不可混箱。

options.text: Include them in the bags for the workshop.
options.zh: 一起放進要送工坊的袋子。
options.whyZh: 送工坊的是已成對且封裝的手套。

options.text: Arrange them in a row on the drying rack.
options.whyZh: 晾乾架用於潮濕的袋子，與未配對散裝手套無關。

options.text: Set aside all left gloves in a separate bin.
options.zh: 把所有左手套集中到另一箱。
options.whyZh: 原文要求放回原箱，沒要求按左右另外集中。

explanationZh: 原文說沒配好就放回原箱，不可混箱。
evidence: put any loose gloves you couldn’t match back in their bin.

evidenceSpans.speaker: N
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: put any loose gloves you couldn’t match back in their bin.

vocabulary.note: unmatched 在此指尚未找到另一手可配成一雙的手套。
